request: API-only v8 runtime deployment preflight; inspect repo, Compose services, healthy containers, no secret values and no modifications.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
v=/home/admin1/projects/astera_v8
l=/home/admin1/projects/libral-vault
printf 'V8_SOURCE_SHA='; git -C "$v" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'V8_STATUS='; git -C "$v" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | wc -l
printf 'V8_CONTAINER_IMAGE='; docker inspect astera-v8 --format '{{.Image}}'
printf 'V8_CURRENT_HEALTH='; docker inspect astera-v8 --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}'
printf 'VAULT_BRANCH='; git -C "$l" branch --show-current
printf 'VAULT_SOURCE_SHA='; git -C "$l" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'VAULT_COMPOSE_SERVICES='; docker compose -f "$l/docker-compose.yml" config --services | tr '\n' ','
printf '\nV8_COMPOSE_SERVICES='; docker compose -f "$v/docker-compose.yml" config --services | tr '\n' ','
printf '\n'
